title: Mass. cannabis regulators found some products have inaccurate THC labels
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: Local News A state audit found that about 20% of the cannabis flower tested fell outside the acceptable range for THC content.

Justin Sullivan / Getty Images Massachusetts cannabis regulators found that 13 of 63 flower products tested from retail stores and medical dispensaries had THC levels outside the state’s acceptable range, according to a recent shelf audit.
The Cannabis Control Commission began the audit in May to check the accuracy of THC labels and help ensure a safe marketplace for consumers and medical marijuana patients.
